author: illwillyum
description: Adds pp: sends pp1, a random 0–7 copies of pp2, and pp3 with no spaces or line breaks. Uses usable custom emojis from the current server.
install_msg: Load with [p]load pp and use [p]pp. The server must have custom emojis named pp1, pp2, and pp3.
end_user_data_statement: This cog does not store user data.
